# Proverbs 4 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 4:1 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Hear, sons, discipline-of a-father, and-attend to-know understanding. |
| LOGOS | Hear, O sons, a father's instruction, and be attentive, that you may gain insight, |
| PNEUMA | Listen up, children — a father is speaking. Pay attention so you can really understand. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
